headline: Revenue softens, losses widen, but full-year guidance holds
summary_short: Q1 2026 revenue was $136 million (-2.2% y/y), while net loss widened to $185 million ($1.84/share) from $151 million ($1.57/share) a year ago; the company reaffirmed full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $730-760 million.
summary_long: Revenue held roughly flat at $136M as Crysvita ($93M, normal seasonality and Brazil ordering patterns) and Dojolvi ($18M) offset Evkeeza's growth to $18M on new-country launches. Total operating expenses rose to $305M from $282M on a $30M restructuring charge and higher R&D ($187M vs $166M), widening the operating loss to $169M and net loss to $185M. Cash and equivalents fell to $175M from $421M last quarter as operations used $197M, including $38M of UX143 manufacturing payments; total cash, equivalents and marketable securities stood at $534M. The company reaffirmed full-year 2026 revenue guidance ($730-760M) and its 2027 profitability target.

drivers.explanation: Crysvita ($93M) tracked expected U.S./Canada seasonality and Brazil ordering patterns; Evkeeza grew to $18M on new-country launches and early access, not enough to offset the total revenue dip.
Decline tracks the revenue dip against a roughly flat cost of sales ($30M vs $29M a year ago), compressing gross profit by a similar proportion.
Total opex rose to $305M from $282M, driven by a $30M restructuring charge (announced last quarter) and higher R&D spend ($187M vs $166M).
Tracks the wider operating loss plus higher non-cash interest expense on liabilities for sales of future royalties ($21M vs $14M a year ago).
Wider net loss combined with a larger diluted share count (100.6M vs 96.3M) both push per-share loss lower.
Company states net cash used in operations included payment of annual bonuses and $38M of payments related to UX143 manufacturing activities.
Decline follows the quarter's $197M operating cash outflow; total liquidity including marketable securities fell to $534M from $737M.
Company reaffirmed full-year 2026 revenue, Crysvita and Dojolvi guidance, citing two BLAs under FDA review (DTX401 PDUFA Aug 23 2026; UX111 PDUFA Sep 19 2026) and Phase 3 GTX-102 data due 2H 2026.
